Rae (CSM): Heads-up  NewLight dedicated pool onboarding is set for next Wed. We need: final quota table, autoscale rules, a short loadtest plan, and renewal-risk mitigation notes. Renewal review is 5 days after go-live so T+72h telemetry + feedback required.
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Copy. What targets for steady vs burst? Any special prefixes to prime?
Maya (SRE): Recommend baseline 160 qps, steady 340 qps, bursts up to 900 qps (1-3m). We'll run: smoke (5m), ramp (25m), soak (60m). Prime these prefixes: /nl/compose, /nl/complete, and the customer-specific prompt list.
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble scripts and a warmup 24h prior to the ramp. Planning to tag requests with x-account:newlight and mirror prod headers.
Chen (Support): I'll be on-call. Share alert thresholds and I'll draft a one-pager triage doc + quick runbook.
Maya (SRE): Alerts: error_rate > 0.8% for 60s -> warn; p95 > 600ms for 90s -> scale; p99 > 1100ms -> page. If p95 > 850ms for 60s, flip fallback to quantized-small pool and roll traffic back by 20%. Also enable token-cost alert: cost_per_1000_tokens > 2x baseline -> notify.
Alex (Product): Product asks for a per-route cost cap and a tiny inline feedback card in the enablement email to capture early UX issues. Also request a temporary flag to disable heavy-generation routes during the soak.
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Load commands I'll run:

```
# smoke
./loadgen --target https://private.redwood/newlight --rps 160 --duration 5m --hdr "x-account:newlight"
# ramp
./loadgen --target https://private.redwood/newlight --rps 340 --duration 25m --pattern ramp --hdr "x-account:newlight"
# soak
./loadgen --target https://private.redwood/newlight --rps 340 --duration 60m --hdr "x-account:newlight"
```

Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): KV priming command:

```
python tools/kv_seed.py --account newlight --file newlight_prompts.json --concurrency 8
```

Maya (SRE): Draft autoscale policy (tune after smoke):

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 18
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 420
  evaluation_window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 120
```

Rae (CSM): I'll message the renewal owner with a short risk note and attach the enablement deck + one-question feedback link. We'll mark NewLight "high-touch" for 14 days post-go-live.
Chen (Support): I'll publish the support playbook and CSAT link. I'll monitor error logs, fallback triggers, and cost alerts during the runs.
deploy-bot: deployment window reserved 2025-01-15T02:00Z for newlight/onboard - ticket CS-12234 :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): Proposed schedule (UTC):
- Tue 23:00: KV warmup (10m)
- Wed 00:00: smoke (5m)
- Wed 00:30: ramp (25m)
- Wed 02:00: soak (60m) + gradual traffic shift and verification
Rae (CSM): Action items:
1) Maya: commit autoscale policy + post runbook link.
2) Ibrahim: upload load scripts + raw metrics to shared drive.
3) Chen: publish support playbook + wire CSAT.
4) Rae: send renewal note + enablement deck + feedback card.
Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
